name: Prompt API (LanguageModel, Gemini Nano)
plain: Runs a local language model in Chrome and lets a page prompt it.
meaning: Page text and the person's input stay on the device. The page can summarise, classify or chat without sending data to a server.

web.api: await LanguageModel.availability(); const s = await LanguageModel.create({temperature,topK,initialPrompts,expectedInputs}); s.prompt(text), promptStreaming()

access.prompt_ui: Download progress on first use; user activation needed before create()
access.persistence: Model stays on disk until eviction (below 10 GB free)
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: Runs a local language model in Chrome and lets a page prompt it.

fields.name: input types
fields.range: text, image (several element types), audio (AudioBuffer, ArrayBuffer, Blob)

fields.name: temperature / topK
fields.range: extensions: default topK 3, max 128; default temp 1, max 2

limits.headline: Can run a small AI model on your device with text you give the page
limits.user_action: You tap a button like Summarize, Reply or Ask AI on the page
can: Send the page text or your message to a local AI model
Get summaries, labels, smart replies or chat answers without a server
Download the model the first time, which can take a while
cannot: Start before a click or tap
Send your text to a server for this feature
Work in Firefox, Safari or on Chrome for Android
Run on computers without enough space and a capable chip
limits.differs: Chrome on desktop supports it; Edge is in testing. Firefox, Safari and all phones do not.

story.what_it_is: A page can talk to a small AI chat model built into Chrome, running on your own computer.

marketing.name: Prompt API
marketing.pitch: Lets web pages send prompts to Gemini Nano in Chrome, so AI features run locally, privately and offline.

story.for_you: A site can offer an AI helper that works without sending your words to a server. You may wait for a model download the first time. It starts after you click or tap.
story.for_makers: Makers get a free, private AI that works offline and costs no cloud fees. It lets them build smart features at scale. The model is small, so results are simpler than big cloud AI.

use_cases.example: A browser role play game uses the local model to make non player characters talk back, with no server bill per player.
A web notes app answers questions about your own notes, with the notes never leaving your device.
A study site quizzes a student on their own text offline on a school laptop.
A chat app suggests replies from the conversation on device.
A store assistant helps pick a product from specs in the page, with no external AI service.
A web design tool suggests names and text for a layout on the device.
A page explains hard terms in simpler words for a reader, with nothing sent out.
A developer builds a form that extracts details from free text on the device.

technical_bounds: Hardware: Windows 10 or 11, macOS 13+, Linux, or ChromeOS Plus; 22 GB free disk; GPU over 4 GB VRAM or CPU with 16 GB RAM and 4 cores
Not on Android, iOS or non Plus ChromeOS
Model removed if free space drops below 10 GB
Not available in Web Workers; cross origin iframes need allow="language-model"
Output can be constrained to a regex or JSON schema

history.change: Prompt API stable on the web (per BCD; page text inconsistent)
